text:
maria: heads-up — customer reported gaps in audit events for tenant dtc-42 during last night's spike. they see sequence holes and some events fail KMS unwrap. :warning:
jamal: ugh. is this the same traffic burst that hit /events-bulk? any 5xx in logs?
maria: yes, spikes ~22k rps for ~3m. logs show intermittent 'kms: decryption failed: transient' and also our validation rejecting events with missing principal_id
olivia: could RBAC change from yesterday cause principal_id stripping? i deployed the rbac-filter patch at 23:05 UTC
devon: i pushed the rbac-filter but it only touches the admission filter before write. shouldn't mutate payload. i'll double-check
kevin: sharing snippet from ingress logs:
```
ERROR ingress.processor: failed to validate event id=evt_9f... reason=principal_id missing
WARN ingress.kms: decrypt error key=projects/redwood/keyrings/.. retryable=true
```
maria: customer says event ids were sequential but holes correspond to our 503/hard rejects. worried about customer-facing validation being too strict
jamal: we intentionally tightened schema to require principal_id and actor.role for compliance. but we can allow soft-fail + tombstone event while we triage.
olivia: proposal: add a temporary compatibility mode that backfills missing fields from x-auth headers for dedicated traffic, and route to slow-path if KMS unwrap fails with retryable=true
devon: for high-volume, slow-path will blow cost. we need batching and KV caching improvements. Suggest: enable 10s batch window with partial ack and background reindexing
kevin: also KMS calls are expensive at scale. can we cache DEKs (data encryption keys) per shard for 30m using HSM-backed ephemeral keys? reduces calls by ~8x
maria: customer wants assurances. can we create a mitigation runbook: 1) enable compat mode, 2) temporary rate-limit non-critical telemetry, 3) enable kms DEK caching, 4) start canary reindex of missing ranges
jamal: + add signed sequence numbers in envelope so replays are detectable. proto change minor: add uint64 seq at top-level with backwards default 0
olivia: rollout plan: feature flag behind ff-audit-compat; canary 5% of tenants tonight; metrics to watch: missing_sequences, kms_retries, ingest_latency_p95
devon: ops: if we hit index saturation, we can fallback to write-to-blob store and async index to ES. preserves durability but increases latency.
audit-bot: incident-log created: INC-2026-054 audit-event-drop-dtc42. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-054
maria: thanks all. action items: devon to validate rbac diff, jamal to implement soft-fail + seq header, kevin to prototype DEK cache, olivia to create canary and dashboards. I'll craft a customer note. :thumbsup:
devon: will do, starting with git diff and unit tests. ping me if you want to pair.
jamal: i'll push a small PR for soft-fail by EOD and add integration test for header fallback
kevin: i'll measure KMS ops and mock DEK cache in staging
olivia: dashboards: `missing_sequences`, `kms_retry_rate`, `ingest_partial_ack_rate`, `bulk_write_latency_p95` — will dashboard and alert thresholds
maria: okey cool. appointing oncall: @olivia for next 6h, @devon for infra followups.
